svg.title: CDN & Edge Caching
svg.desc: CDN & Edge Caching. Serve static content from edge locations close to users; only cache misses reach the origin. Step 1, First request: a miss: Bangkok's edge has no copy of /app.9f3c.js: a MISS. It fetches it from the far origin and stores it. Step 2, Hits near the user: Bangkok's next requests are HITs from the edge in ~15 ms. Every other edge fills its own cache. Step 3, Expiry and revalidation: The page's max-age runs out. The edge revalidates with its ETag: 304, no body, fresh again. Step 4, Changing content: Deploy: the new script has a new URL, so no purge. The page keeps its URL: purged, then a MISS.
